eras.title: The plaza on the ridge
eras.caption: Monte Albán's broad plaza occupies a levelled hilltop above the valleys of Oaxaca. Stone platforms and stairways still organise the open space of this Zapotec capital, with the surrounding landscape visible beyond its edges.
